natural_language_analysis.summary: All seven current manual obligations are semantically derivable from the existing annotation-approved specifications and case-lib lemmas. The qualification-only source change does not alter any witness meaning.

vc_shape.pre_pure: xizi_double_link_next_anchor head (ptrs nodes) node, hence member or sentinel
vc_shape.pre_exists: store_dll decomposition supplies sentinel endpoints and the complete segment
vc_shape.post_spatial: Either payloads plus a segment cut at node and its fields, or unchanged sentinel fields and full segment
vc_shape.post_pure: Member first-occurrence split and dispatch/suffix equality, or node=head and sentinel dispatch equality
vc_shape.post_exists: Member: node_next, node_prev, first, last, before, after; sentinel: first, last

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Decompose store_dll for first/last. For membership use the first-occurrence lemma for before/after, segment cut for node_prev/node_next, and store exclusion for node<>head. For sentinel keep the complete segment.
witnesses.space_plan: Decompose store_dll; cut addr_dllseg at the first member occurrence or directly cancel the unchanged sentinel resources.
witnesses.pure_plan: In the member branch, membership plus store exclusion proves node<>head, then dispatch-at-first-occurrence gives the result equality. In the sentinel branch substitute node=head and unfold dispatch.
premise_discharge: Membership comes from the left anchor disjunct.
The first-occurrence lemma supplies nodes=before++node::after and ~In node before.
store_dll entails ~In head (ptrs nodes), so member membership entails node<>head.
Segment cut supplies the exact node fields and two segments required by the postcondition.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Shares the same store/segment and dispatch helper family as the return and derive witnesses.

vc_shape.post_exists: None beyond selecting one equivalent top-level disjunct

witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite first=head and node=head; ptrs nodes=nil reduces first_value to zero, and PreH3 supplies dispatch equality.
premise_discharge: The segment begins and ends at head after first=head.
The original resources exactly satisfy store-close.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the common segment observation and store reconstruction pattern.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Retain before/after and all existing endpoints.
witnesses.space_plan: Use the sentinel next field and suffix segment starting at head to prove after=nil, rejoin the segments around node, rewrite the list equation, and close store_dll.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH4 gives dispatch=first_value after; after=nil makes it zero.
premise_discharge: node_next=head supplies the empty-observation start.
The precondition has all rejoin resources.
The list equation identifies the rejoined list with ptrs nodes.

PreH2 identifies the rejoined list.
PreH4 bridges suffix observation to dispatch.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open or preserve store_dll, reason over the same complete/cut segment and dispatch observation, then rejoin/close or frame the unchanged store.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Store decomposition/closure, segment cut/rejoin or direct cancellation, and unchanged-store framing.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Anchor/dispatch definitions plus first-occurrence, empty-suffix, nonempty-suffix, or sentinel/member facts.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All witnesses are one function and one helper family; 7 is below the limit of 12, so one worker can proceed continuously.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove dispatch entailment by store decomposition, first-occurrence splitting, and segment cut; prove returns with empty/nonempty observations, rejoin, and store close; finish contract bridges by identical abstract-state instantiation and sentinel/member dispatch reduction under the wand.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: One bounded same-function cluster sharing the dispatch/store/segment family; this minimizes spawns and reuses one proof context.
